div.div:
رَضَاعَةٌ , said in the K to be an inf. n. of 1 in the first of the senses explained in this art., is, accord. to IAth, a simple subst. (TA.) ―
-b2- [It is a regular inf. n. of رَضُعَ, q. v.] ＝
-A2- الرَّضَاعَةُ also signifies (tropical:) The [west wind, or westerly wind, called] دَبُور: or a wind between that and the [south wind, or southerly wind, called] جَنُوب: (IDrd, K, TA:) because, when it blows upon the milch-camels abounding with milk, their milk becomes little in quantity. (IDrd, TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
